scope: Isolated spatial/depth study of C2 PBF; production unchanged. CPU reference costs only, measured on primary PC.

depth_controls.mass: density*area*depth; consistent equal particle masses, record unavoidable sample-count choices explicitly

criteria.convergence: Successive spatial changes in centroid/height decrease and are <=5%/10% of independent target at the two finest tested spacings; temporal/iteration controls must not materially reverse the conclusion.

volume_measurements: height-map geometric volume (label reconstruction and wetting sensitivity)
independent wall-normalized C2 field 0.5 isosurface volume; threshold sensitivity .45/.55 and sampling sensitivity reported
controls: inset 0 versus .25dx versus .5dx at fixed other controls
boundary density on/off at fixed other controls
flat tank with the same geometry and mass as collision at each spatial resolution
same dx across a fluid-depth ladder
half dt and increased iterations on admitted/refutation endpoints
evidence: Immutable per-run requests, complete scheduled raw p/v/wall streams, fsync, gzip/readback SHA256, local durable directory and primary home mirror; retain unsuccessful cases.
alternative_gate: Only investigate a simple isolated volume-aware free-surface alternative if properly controlled refinement does not recover physical accuracy; no complex thin-film method without evidence.
